items.prompt: Starting with three fourths… …we’ve seen that to write an equivalent fraction with twenty on the bottom… …an equation like this one will help us. 3/4 × ▢/▢ = ▢/20 Next, to make an equivalent fraction, this must have a value of 1. So top and bottom must be the same. Four times five is equal to twenty. So we write five here... and here… 3/4 × 5/5 = ▢/20 Now, finally, three times five is fifteen, so we write fifteen here.
items.demo: Three fourths… is equivalent to *fifteen over twenty*.

items.prompt: If we wanted an equivalent fraction that had forty on the bottom, we would write this: 3/4 × ▢/▢ = ▢/40 Four times what is equal to forty? Four times ten is equal to forty. So we write ten here... and here… 3/4 × 10/10 = ▢/40 And then finally, three times ten is thirty.
items.demo: So, three fourths… is equivalent to *thirty over forty*.

items.prompt: If we wanted an equivalent fraction that had six on the top, we would write this: 3/4 × ▢/▢ = 6/▢ Three times what is equal to six? Three times two is equal to six. So we write two here… and here… 3/4 × 2/2 = 6/▢ And, finally, four times two is eight.
items.demo: So, three fourths… is equivalent to *six over eight*.
